message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate data, but as a rough estimate:

- **$20 USD ≈ £15.60 GBP** (using an approximate rate of 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP).

Exchange rates fluctuate constantly, so the exact amount you’d receive could be slightly higher or lower depending on the current market rate and any fees your bank or service may charge. If you need the most accurate figure, it’s best to check a reliable financial news source, a currency‑conversion website, or your banking app right before you make the transaction.
